## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — tahoe/math.

`config.mk` records 31 source file(s) here: `fpe.c`, `Kaddd.s`, `Kaddf.s`, `Katanf.s`, `Kcmpd.s`, `Kcmpf.s`, `Kcvtdl.s`, `Kcvtfl.s`, `Kcvtld.s`, `Kcvtlf.s`, `Kdivd.s`, `Kdivf.s`, ....

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
